Name: What is an IP address and Octet?
Author: mgriffis

xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">What an IP Address Really Is</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">An IPv4 address is a 32-bit number used to identify a device on a network.</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">Because 32 bits is hard to read, it’s broken into four 8-bit sections.</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">Why It’s Called an Octet</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">Octet = 8 bits</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">8 bits can represent 256 values (0–255)</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">IPv4 = 4 octets × 8 bits = 32 bits</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">Example:</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">192.168.214.37</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve">Octet	Binary	Decimal</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve">192	11000000	Network</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve">168	10101000	Network</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve">214	11010110	Network</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve">37	00100101	Device</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">The term octet exists because not all systems historically used 8-bit bytes — “octet” removes ambiguity.</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">Network vs Device (Street Address Analogy)</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">Think of an IP like a mailing address:</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">192.168.214.37</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">192.168.214 → Street</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">37 → House number</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">If two devices are not on the same “street,” they cannot talk directly.</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">Your Two Networks (Critical)</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">192.168.214.x → Network A</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">192.168.213.x → Network B</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF" xml:space="preserve" /><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">Even though they look similar, 214 ≠ 213</Paragraph><Paragraph Margin="0,0,0,0" Padding="0,0,0,0" TextAlignment="Left" FlowDirection="LeftToRight" Foreground="#FFFFFFFF">That single number change means different networks.</Paragraph></FlowDocument>
